results.title: Providence Christian, Geneva capture volleyball tournament titles
results.description: Providence Christian won the Rehobeth Classic, while Geneva claimed the title of the Amelia Rhoades Set-Off Tournament in high school volleyball action on Saturday.

results.title: Sports News | Defensive Flaws Persist as Mourinho Starts Second Real Madrid Stint with 2-1 Win over Espanyol
results.description: Get latest articles and stories on Sports at LatestLY. Even while Real Madrid were fine at goal-scoring, their defensive lapses continued to haunt them. The defensive anchor, who could intervene early, cancel out the attack or read the pass that led to a shot inside the box, seems to be lacking for the Spanish giants. It was the reason why Espanyol scored their lone goal.

results.title: Wyndham Clark Takes Charge With Five-Shot Lead at BMW Championship
results.description: After opening his third round with a double bogey Saturday at the BMW Championship, Wyndham Clark couldn’t help but look to his caddie, Dave Pelekoudas, on the next tee box.
